description:
Set typing in a Space

Saves one transient typing update as an authorized Agent in this Space. Returns the dispatched Message with HTTP 202. Successful provider handoff ends in accepted; rejection or expiry ends in failed. Repeat true to refresh; false stops where supported. Callers control refreshes. Unsupported platforms return OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/spaces/set-typing-in-a-space

typing.description: True starts or refreshes typing; false stops it.

confirmedRecipients.description: Optional complete list of confirmed recipient snapshots, each with a Photon userId and the handle used for the original send. Omit when the full confirmed set cannot be identified or disclosed; omission does not mean zero deliveries.
